main.summary: Registry for Tool-owned named service scopes.
main.remarks: Owns the default named Tool scope plus any additional named scopes, and coordinates acquisition and final disposal semantics.

field.name: DefaultScopeName
field.summary: Reserved registry name used for the Tool's lifetime-owned default service scope.

field.name: disposing
field.summary: True after registry disposal has claimed ownership and new scope operations are no longer allowed.

field.name: scopes
field.summary: Named-scope registry keyed by scope name using ordinal string comparison.

field.name: services
field.summary: Root Tool service provider used to create new named service scopes.

field.name: sync
field.summary: Synchronization lock that guards all registry mutations and lookups.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a new Tool service scope registry.
constructor.param: Root Tool-owned service provider used to create named scopes.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create a new named Tool service scope and acquire its first handle.
method.returns: New Tool service scope handle, or null when creation is rejected.

method.name: Get
method.summary: Acquire a handle for an existing named Tool service scope.
method.returns: Tool service scope handle, or null when the scope cannot be acquired.

method.name: GetDefault
method.summary: Acquire a handle for the default named Tool service scope.

method.name: GetNames
method.summary: Get the names of all currently registered Tool service scopes.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Dispose all registered Tool service scopes synchronously.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Dispose all registered Tool service scopes asynchronously.
method.returns: A ValueTask that represents the asynchronous disposal operation.

method.name: RemoveEntry
method.summary: Removes a named scope from the registry when the registered entry is the retiring owner.
method.param: Name of the named scope to remove from the registry.
method.returns: True if the named scope entry was removed; otherwise false.
